item.text: The existing stream engine is in place, but the core AST nodes for field/index/iteration were evaluating against the original input instead of their chained base expression. That explains the acceptance failure for `.items[1]` and `.[...]`; I’m correcting base-aware evaluation and adding focused core tests for composition, collection, indexing, optional access, and slices.
